objective: Reduce the time a work item spends between claim and completion, without weakening independent review or hiding how much of the population is actually measured.
invariants: a latency metric is reportable only while its measurement coverage is declared alongside it
an uninstrumented work item is counted as missing, never as fast

stop_rules.condition: claim_event_coverage_ratio is below the declared floor, so the latency metrics describe a self-selected subset rather than the population.
Producer and reviewer identities are not distinct for any sampled work item.
rework_rate rises while claim_to_complete_ms falls, which is latency bought with quality.

rollback.trigger: any invariant failure or stop rule
